Emily Chan: Heads-up — Origami deck (enterprise ed-tech) wants a quick 2-week POC. They provided a custom variant 'origami-35b-adapt' with an altered tokenizer and modified KV layout. Need: (1) compatibility check with our catalog, (2) edge pricing for dedicated capacity for a 2-week POC (~5k req/day), (3) answers for KMS + EU data residency items in their security questionnaire. Any immediate blockers? @Ashwin
Ashwin Rao: quick scan — looks Llama-like but tokenizer changes can break batching + KV assumptions. Drop model artifact link and tokenizer config? Also ask if they expect quantized variant (q4/8-bit).
Emily Chan: link + tokenizer snippet uploaded: https://uploads.origami.co/models/origami-35b-adapt.tar.gz
Snippet: ```tokens.json {"special_tokens": ["<USR>", "<SYS>"]}```
They said q4 or 8-bit acceptable.
Nina Park: Security Q — they require customer-managed KMS and EU residency. We can offer Private/VPC for residency but lead time ~2w. Need to clarify logs/metrics retention and where they live. @Kai?
Kai Morales: Dedicated pool feasible but need short commit. Baseline perf: 2x A100s for steady 5k req/day (medium prompts). Cost ballpark: ~$6k/day for reserved+burst; q4 reduces to ~3.5k/day. Tokenizer mismatch may reduce batching efficiency — suggest ingress normalization.
Ashwin Rao: Ops checklist: 1) tokenizer test harness vs tokens.json 2) KV cache compatibility 3) quantization smoke (q4) 4) license check. I can run 1+2 today with creds.
Emily Chan: creds shared: svc-origami-poc (expires 48h). Uploaded partial security questionnaire. Can we reply with timeline + pricing options by EOD?
ops-bot: Ticket created #P-4821 for tokenizer + KV tests. Assigned Ashwin Rao. ETA 2024-08-03.
Kai Morales: If tokenizer test fails, fallback is lightweight pre-token mapping in request pipeline (adds ~5-8ms p99). Prefer that over delaying POC.
Nina Park: Legal needs full model license and training data disclosure for their questionnaire. I'll escalate; ETA 24-48h.
Emily Chan: Thanks — Ashwin please report test results here. I'll draft three pricing options: hosted trial (limited tokens), dedicated 2-week reserved, private deploy (EU residency). :thumbsup:
